item.title: Nice little curl commands
item.description: A collection of useful curl-friendly web services for checking things like weather, IP addresses, files, translations, and cryptocurrency rates from the terminal.

item.title: Automatize your logins with gnome-keyring (and optionally with KeePassXC)
